title: Build scripts: survive empty codesign arrays under bash 3.2
paragraphs: With an Apple Development identity in the keychain, the record-it, record-meeting and Meeting Archive Worker launcher builds leave their codesign requirements arrays empty. /usr/bin/env bash on macOS is 3.2, where expanding an empty array under set -u is an unbound-variable error, so each build aborted at codesign.
Use ${arr[@]+"${arr[@]}"} as phone-mirror already does. Telemprompit's extra-quoted variant worked, but now matches the same form.

Both a debug and a release rebuild of each app signed with the certificate kept Screen Recording, Camera, Microphone and Input Monitoring without a prompt, because the stored ad-hoc requirement (identifier only) still matches. AGENTS.md now says the stable requirement only applies to the ad-hoc fallback.

title: Constant-quality screen recording presets
paragraphs: Screen recordings shared the camera's rate control. With CQP 30 saved, screen files averaged 0.85 Mbps and dark gradients broke into blocks at 2-3x punch-ins. Add a screen-only Screen quality preset (Edit Master 0.95, High 0.9, Standard = shared settings) using VideoToolbox constant quality, defaulting to Edit Master. Camera settings are unchanged.

title: Never stop a take on a detected problem
paragraphs: A static screen made ScreenCaptureKit stop sending frames, the 10 second watchdog read that as a stall, and the whole take was stopped. Stopping never saved anything, so problems now sound the alarm and ask whether to keep recording while every source keeps writing.

- Ignore screen silence after an idle frame
- Log each problem with its time into the take and save <take>-problems.txt
- Write movies in 5 second fragments so a crash leaves a playable file
- Finalize every recorder independently so one error can't abandon another file
- Suffix reused take names instead of deleting existing files
- Keep the backup-audio helper recording through problems as quiet warnings, and close its file cleanly if Record It crashes
- Refuse to start under 10 GB free and alarm under 5 GB mid-take
